_authoring.purpose: AI context for milking events and reactions to completed milking.
_authoring.player_controls: How the method, relief and recorded outcome are described.
_authoring.contains: Start/end event descriptions, method-specific completion text and response instructions.
_authoring.perspective: The milked character owns the experience; completion narration reacts to her recorded session.
_authoring.boundary: Does not start milking or decide how much milk was removed or retained.

_help: Edit template text or replace a template with a string array. Keep the documented placeholders. Use MCM Reload Narration JSON after saving.

complete_hands.template: {actor} finishes a hands-on milking, pleasantly relieved and satisfied. {result}

complete_pump.template: The pump finishes drawing milk from {actor}, leaving her lighter and pleasantly refreshed. {result}

complete_equipment.template: The milking cups finish their work on {actor}, leaving her relieved and pleasantly sensitive. {result}

complete_tendrils.template: Living tendrils have drawn milk from {actor}, leaving her breathless and pleasantly spent. {result}

complete_dwemer.template: The Dwemer mechanism finishes its rhythmic harvest from {actor}, leaving her dazed and deliciously satisfied. {result}

complete_productive.template: {actor} completed a productive {method} milking session. Milk was extracted, but production or feeding left no net reduction in her reserves.

result_empty.template: Her milk reserves were empty at completion.

completion_instruction.template: React as {actor} to this source-specific milking experience and its aftermath. Describe the completed session, not a new or ongoing one.
